timing_policy: One measured call per input/solver; first OR-Tools call includes cold import. No warmup or averaging.

rationale: Maximize feasible new assignments before allocation priority, then minimize rounded millimeter travel and break ties by sorted casualty/responder IDs. Human-confirmed immediate=2, delayed=1, minor=0 allocation points. Unassessed, future-assessed, expectant and deceased receive protected 2-point allocation parity with immediate, NOT an inferred medical severity. There is no automatic clinical expectant/deceased deprioritization. These recommendations require human review and do not authorize dispatch.

Only available, unreserved, capability-compatible responders with verified grid routes enter the shared candidate graph. Missing observations do not infer uncertainty; supplied uncertain observations block new work, never existing work.
Nearest baseline greedily selects shortest feasible pairs; it does not guarantee maximum count, urgency, or minimum total travel.
